description: Returns exercises from the team library and stock libraries. Use when the user wants to browse exercises, find exercises for workouts, or manage the library. Returns exercise IDs for create_exercise_instance, create_exercise_group and generate_video_clip.

availability.description: Which library: "all" (team + stock), "team" (your own exercises), "free-stock", "premium-stock" or "all-stock" (both stock libraries).

categories.description: Only show these exercise categories, e.g. ["strength", "mobility"].

coach.description: Only show this coach in the video: "male" or "female".

collection_names.description: Only show exercises from these collections (free-text collection names), e.g. ["John from Hyperhuman"].

equipment_ids.description: Only show exercises using this equipment. IDs from list_equipment.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

muscle_group_ids.description: Only show exercises for these muscle groups. IDs from list_muscle_groups.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

search_text.description: Text to search names for, e.g. "core". Omit to list everything.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

name: list_team_exercises
title: List team exercises
